Package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog

Class ControlIQCycleHistoryLog

java.lang.Object
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.HistoryLog
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.ControlIQCycleHistoryLog
public class ControlIQCycleHistoryLog extends HistoryLog
Control-IQ's state for one 5-minute algorithm cycle: its glucose estimate and prediction, net IOB, TDI estimate, correction factor, target, the programmed basal it starts from, and what it commands (the hypoglycemia brake, the cycle's insulin and the increase above profile). Written every ~300 s on t:slim X2 and Mobi, including with Control-IQ off and with no CGM, directly before opcode 327 in the same second and before the next BasalDeliveryHistoryLog (about 30 s later on Mobi, about 90 s on the X2).

Evidence, from about 11,000 records in 10 pump datasets: getProgrammedBasalRate() matches the next BasalDelivery's programmed rate in 99.5%; getHypoBrake() is the stated function of getPredictedGlucoseX100() in 96-100% per dataset; with Control-IQ on, getCycleInsulinMilliunits() is the next BasalDelivery's algorithm rate over 12 (plus any automatic correction bolus) in 98-99%. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/146.

These are pump-internal Control-IQ values. Do not use them for dosing or as the IOB.

The class name is provisional: opcode 227 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi app's history log list. getSleepRamp() is exposed raw because its meaning is unknown.

    • getBasalIncreaseMilliunits

      public int getBasalIncreaseMilliunits()
      floor(max(0, algorithmRate - profileBasalRate) / 12) for the next BasalDeliveryHistoryLog. Nonzero only when Control-IQ raises basal above the profile (never with Control-IQ off).
      Returns:
      the cycle's basal increase above the profile rate, in milliunits per 5 minutes

    • getCycleInsulinMilliunits

      public int getCycleInsulinMilliunits()
      With Control-IQ on: floor(algorithmRate / 12) for the next BasalDeliveryHistoryLog, plus the requested amount of a Control-IQ automatic correction bolus started in this cycle. With Control-IQ off: close to floor(programmedBasalRate / 12 * hypoBrakeFraction) (81-99% of records on three Mobis), which the pump then does not deliver.
      Returns:
      the insulin the algorithm computes for this cycle, in milliunits

    • getPredictedGlucoseX100

      public int getPredictedGlucoseX100()
      Predicted glucose x100, floored at 2000. Roughly the glucose estimate plus 20 minutes of the recent CGM trend, minus an insulin effect; the exact prediction horizon is not confirmed.
      Returns:
      the predicted glucose in mg/dL x 100

    • getPredictedGlucoseMgdl

      public double getPredictedGlucoseMgdl()
      Returns:
      getPredictedGlucoseX100() in mg/dL

    • getProgrammedBasalRate

      public int getProgrammedBasalRate()
      The active temp rate if one is running, else the profile rate; the profile rate while suspended. Capped at 3000. On Control-IQ v7.6 Mobi firmware this is the profile rate even during a temp rate.
      Returns:
      the programmed basal rate, in milliunits/hr

    • getNetIobMilliunits

      public int getNetIobMilliunits()
      Not the IOB the pump displays. Fits boluses plus (delivered - programmed) basal through a two-compartment curve (1 + t/tau) * e^(-t/tau) with tau = 34 minutes, floored at 0 (r 0.97-0.9998 in 8 datasets).
      Returns:
      the algorithm's net insulin on board, in milliunits

    • getGlucoseEstimate

      public int getGlucoseEstimate()
      Tracks the latest CGM reading (r 0.997-0.998, usually 1 mg/dL below it) and saturates at 255. With no CGM paired to the pump it stays near a fixed value.
      Returns:
      the algorithm's current glucose estimate, in mg/dL

    • getCorrectionFactor

      public int getCorrectionFactor()
      min(floor(1800 / TDI estimate), profile correction factor) in 2024-2026 data; 1500 instead of 1800 in the 2022 records and part of 2023.
      Returns:
      the correction factor the algorithm uses, in mg/dL per unit

    • getHypoBrake

      public int getHypoBrake()
      floor(200 / (1 + 2.5 * r)) for predicted glucose G = getPredictedGlucoseMgdl() >= 70, and 0 below 70, where r = 10 * f^2 when f = 1.509 * (ln(G)^1.084 - 5.381) is negative and 0 otherwise (Kovatchev's low-BG risk, zero at 112.5 mg/dL). 200 means no attenuation.
      Returns:
      the hypoglycemia brake factor, 0-200

    • getHypoBrakeFraction

      public double getHypoBrakeFraction()
      Returns:
      getHypoBrake() as a fraction, 0.0 (full brake) to 1.0 (none)

    • getSleepRamp

      public int getSleepRamp()
      0 outside sleep. In sleep mode it rises by 3 or 4 per cycle (40 per hour) to 200 over five hours; after sleep ends it falls by 4-5 per cycle. Meaning unknown.
      Returns:
      raw uint8 at offset 24
